boundary: Cloud browser infrastructure and browser-agent platform; it provides sessions and execution primitives, not evidence of a general app-builder artifact model.
workflows: Create a browser session, connect with Stagehand/Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium, automate pages, and optionally invoke browser agents through Cloud Functions.
prompting_planning: Stagehand provides LLM-powered browser control and self-healing automation; formal plan/checkpoint semantics are unknown.
generated_artifacts: Browser session state, recordings, screenshots and automation results are documented; generated application source/schema are unknown.
data_auth_integration: Browser sessions can support login flows and integrations through automation frameworks; credential scope, vault semantics and data-source connectors are unknown.
ui_design: UI validation and browser interaction are supported; design generation and accessibility guarantees are unknown.
runtime_sandbox: Isolated cloud browser sessions and configurable browser settings are documented; full tenant, network and agent identity controls are unknown.
deploy_export: Cloud Functions and session connectivity are documented; application deployment/export and infrastructure portability are unknown.
collaboration: Session sharing/observability is indicated by recordings and hosted sessions; multi-user edit/review semantics are unknown.
recovery: Session recordings and screenshots aid debugging; browser-state restore, data recovery and deterministic replay are unknown.
governance_security: Browser isolation and proxy/browser configuration are documented at product level; retention, audit export and enterprise control detail are unknown.
economics: Usage/pricing exists as a product concern but exact current unit economics were not promoted from the reviewed pages.
contradictions: Browserbase is sometimes positioned as browser-agent infrastructure and sometimes as testing infrastructure; dossier keeps the narrower common boundary and does not infer app generation.

boundary: LLM/computer-vision browser automation platform with tasks, workflows and cloud/local browser modes; not evidence of a general application builder.

prompting_planning: Tasks accept natural-language goals and optional JSON schemas; workflow generation from a prompt and max-step controls are documented.
generated_artifacts: Typed extraction output, signed downloaded files, workflow versions and generated scripts are documented; app source/schema are unknown.
data_auth_integration: Encrypted credentials, external vaults, browser profiles and persistent sessions are documented; exact provider scopes and data export are unknown.
ui_design: Screenshot/DOM understanding supports browser interaction; design creation and accessibility validation are unknown.
runtime_sandbox: Cloud Chromium and a self-hostable local browser mode are documented; complete isolation/network policy and agent identity are unknown.
deploy_export: Cloud API, local server and self-host option are documented; portable workflow/runtime export and infrastructure parity are unknown.
collaboration: Cloud workflows can be shared and versioned; detailed roles/approval semantics are unknown.
recovery: Sessions/profiles preserve browser state and run artifacts aid debugging; external side effects and full rollback are unknown.
governance_security: Credentials are encrypted and not sent to the LLM per docs; tenant isolation, audit export and retention are unknown.
economics: Max steps control AI decision cycles and cost; exact current plan prices and full usage model are unknown.
contradictions: Cloud sessions can persist up to 24 hours while profiles persist longer; neither is treated as a general data-restore guarantee.

economics: Open-source positioning is documented; current hosted pricing and runtime usage units are unknown.
